apps.name: Feather PDF
apps.subtitle: A fast, free PDF reader and editor.
apps.localizedDescription: Read, find, edit text and equations, highlight, draw, add notes, turn and delete pages, and manage the PDF files on your iPhone. No account, no tracking.
apps.versionDescription: iPhone and iPad: Search for PDF files on your iPhone and a PDF file manager (rename, move, duplicate, delete...); recent documents open again; new versions download at once.
